agent_summary: The Apple MacBook Air 13-inch laptop was verified on Apple's official online store at a published base price of $1,299, which matches the one-time purchase price stated on the application exactly. Full-page and targeted screenshots were captured to document the product availability, general specifications, and pricing. The application indicates no specialized safety features, and the product page confirms standard consumer laptop features. However, the requested item constitutes computer hardware, which is explicitly listed on the Household Related Items exclusion list. The reviewer's attention is directed to this exclusion determination for final eligibility assessment.
